In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $1,594,985</cite> while directing a <cite id="3">Program expense ratio of 100.0%</cite> toward its religious and educational programming [3]. This exceeds the <cite id="1">peer program ratio median of 93.7%</cite> for similar religious and cultural entities [1]. rich_narrative.summary: Darul Huda Corporation provides religious, cultural, and educational services to the Muslim community in Springfield, Virginia [3]. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $1,594,985</cite> to support its core community operations [3]. Its offerings include <cite id="3">prayer services, Quran recitation, and Islamic studies classes</cite> [3]. The charity maintains a strong financial cushion, holding <cite id="1">14.7 months of working capital</cite> in reserves [1]. Additionally, filings show a <cite id="3">Program expense ratio of 100.0%</cite>, indicating all reported spending is allocated toward mission activities [3]. However, critical limiting factors constrain the organization's overall evaluation. Darul Huda Corporation lacks documented outcome metrics, has an unverified evidence base, and provides weak board governance disclosure [3]. Public evaluation from Charity Navigator yields an <cite id="1">overall score of 84/100</cite> [1]. While the organization successfully provides direct religious services locally, its lack of rigorous evaluation makes it difficult to assess long-term community impact [3].
